verdict.rationale: cubic is primarily a code-review tool; its only code-generation capability is the narrow 'Fix with cubic' feature that generates a fix for a flagged review comment and pushes it to the PR branch, not a general 'describe a feature/bug in plain language and implement across multiple files' agent workflow. Missing for 10: evidence of accepting a free-form feature/bug description, multi-file implementation, and end-to-end feature delivery (cubic instead defers actual coding to external agents like Claude Code/Cursor via MCP integration).
